info.title: Hansho hub sender API
info.description: The one contract of the Hansho SDKs. Edit this file, run `go run ./scripts/gen` in sdk/, and implement the operation in every SDK: CI names the ones that miss it. `x-name` is the field name every SDK uses when it differs from the wire name; `x-header` is a field sent as a request header, never in the body. `x-conformance` holds the exact requests the SDKs must produce and answers the hub gives, which every SDK test suite replays.

post.summary: Creates a single-use pairing ticket for a user of your system (valid for 10 minutes).

display_name.description: What other people see for the user instead of their id (trimmed, at most 40 characters, no control characters).

put.summary: Sets what other people see for the user instead of their external user id. An empty name clears it. The user need not be paired yet.

delete.summary: Revokes every pairing of the user, on every device (the SDKs also call it kick).

put.summary: Creates or replaces a channel. Ids match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}.

get.summary: Returns a channel; a missing one is error `unknown_channel`.
Lists every template at its latest version.

put.summary: Stores a template version; the version must increase.

get.summary: Returns a template; a missing one is error `unknown_template`.

delete.summary: Deletes a template. One a live channel still names is refused with 409 `in_use`.

put.summary: Uploads a notification sound (at most 1 MB).

get.summary: Returns a sound's metadata; a missing one is error `unknown_sound`.

delete.summary: Deletes a sound. One a live channel still names is refused with 409 `in_use`.

put.summary: Creates a group or replaces its whole member list. Ids match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}.

get.summary: Returns a group; a missing one is error `unknown_group`.

delete.summary: Deletes a group. An audience that still names it matches nobody through it.

put.summary: Sets the data behind a widget and asks the devices to reload.

get.summary: Returns a feed's settings without its data; a missing one is error `unknown_feed`.

parameters.name: external_user_id
parameters.description: Leave out for the feed shared by all users.

post.summary: Starts a Live Activity on the user's devices.

patch.summary: Pushes new content to a running Live Activity. Never retried automatically.

post.summary: Sends a notification, or a page at level `page`. Never retried automatically unless it carries an idempotency key.

get.summary: Returns a message's status and per-device deliveries.

post.summary: The pairing.created event. Its `data` object is a PairingCreated.
The pairing.revoked event. Its `data` object is a PairingRevoked.
The message.delivered event. Its `data` object is a MessageDelivered.
The message.undeliverable event. Its `data` object is a MessageUndeliverable.
The message.acked event. Its `data` object is a MessageAcked.
The message.dismissed event. Its `data` object is a MessageDismissed.
The message.expired event. Its `data` object is a MessageExpired.
The action event. Its `data` object is a ActionTaken.
The activity.ended event. Its `data` object is a ActivityEnded.

apiKey.description: A sender API key from `hub apikey create`.

Level.description: How loudly a message is presented, lowest to highest. The hub delivers min(requested or the channel default, the channel max).

AudienceMode.description: How an audience reads its lists: everyone, only the listed users and groups, or everyone except them.

PageAck.description: Who must acknowledge a page sent to several people: `any` (the hub default) stops it for everyone at the first acknowledgement, `each` keeps paging each person until they acknowledge for themselves.

Action.description: A button shown with a message or channel. Pressing an `ack` action on a page acknowledges it.

url.description: For kind `url`: the https URL the button opens.

PairingTicket.description: A single-use pairing ticket, valid for 10 minutes.

qr.description: Render this string as a QR code for the user to scan in the app.

Audience.description: Says who may use a channel or feed. `users` are your external user ids (they may not have paired yet) and `groups` are group ids (a group that does not exist has no members). Both must be empty for `everyone`.

Group.description: A named list of users, used in audiences.

Channel.description: Groups messages and gives them defaults.

id.description: Set by the hub in answers; ignored when sent.

audience.description: Who may use the channel. Leaving it out keeps the stored audience; send mode `everyone` to open the channel up. Reading a channel always returns it.

PageOptions.description: Tunes a page (level `page`). A zero or absent field means the hub default.

max_retries.description: Resends before the page expires (hub default 5).

Message.description: A notification for one user, for several, or for a channel's audience. Users outside the channel's audience are not delivered to: their recipient has status `no_access`.

external_user_id.description: Exactly one of `external_user_id`, `external_user_ids` and `to_audience` is required.

external_user_ids.description: Sends to several users at once (at most 1000).

to_audience.description: Sends to every paired user in the channel's audience, resolved when you send.

data.description: Template data, sent as given: its keys are never renamed.

idempotency_key.description: Opts this send in to retries of 429 and 503. Sent as the Idempotency-Key header, never in the body. The hub ignores it today, so a retried send is at-least-once.

Delivery.description: The state of a message on one device.

Recipient.description: The outcome of a send for one user.

status.description: The message status (queued, undeliverable) or `no_access`, with no message id.

MessageResult.description: The answer to a send. For a send to one `external_user_id` the other fields describe that recipient; for several users or an audience they are empty and each message is under `recipients`.

MessageStatus.description: A message's status and per-device deliveries.

status.description: One of queued, delivered, undeliverable, paging, acked, expired.

acked_at.description: When a page was acknowledged; absent until then.

acked_by.description: Who acknowledged a page: their external user id.

acked_by_name.description: The display name of whoever acknowledged, only when they have one.

ActivityAlert.description: The optional banner shown with a Live Activity change.

Activity.description: Starts a Live Activity from a template.

data.description: Any JSON value, sent and returned as is: its keys are never renamed.
Any JSON value, sent and returned as is: its keys are never renamed.

ActivityStarted.description: The answer to starting a Live Activity.

ActivityUpdated.description: The answer to updating a Live Activity: `update` counts the updates so far.

external_user_id.description: Leave out for a feed shared by all paired users.

title.description: The name the app's feed picker shows instead of the id (at most 64 bytes).

channel.description: The feed uses this channel's audience unless it sets its own.

audience.description: Who may see the feed. With neither this nor `channel` it is for everyone. Title, channel and audience are replaced by every put, so send them with each update.

data.description: Any JSON value, sent and returned as is: its keys are never renamed.

audience.description: Absent while the feed inherits its channel's audience.

FeedResult.description: The answer to putting a feed: `devices` is how many were asked to reload.

SoundResult.description: The answer to a sound upload.

acked_by.description: Who acknowledged (an external user id; differs from `external_user_id` when a page went to several people).

acked_by_name.description: Their display name, only when they have one.

MessageDismissed.description: Means the person swiped away a message that asked to be acknowledged, without acknowledging it.

text.description: The reply text of a text action, if any.

x-conformance.comment: Paths are the escaped request paths. `operation` is the operationId the case exercises.
